spec.title: Environment
spec.summary: A varlock-compatible .env.schema and the vault item paths its keys bind to.

fields.label: Environment
fields.help: The environment name used in the generated file: development, staging or production.

fields.label: env.schema
fields.help: The varlock @env-spec body. Holds keys, decorators and rules, never a value.

fields.label: Vault item aliases
fields.help: One KEY=vault/item/path binding per line. The key must appear in the schema; the path may be any named vault item path.
